chunks: And Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub narrated from al-Abbas from Bakr ibn Muhammad, who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: "The superiority of the first time [of prayer] over the last time is better for the believer than his children and his wealth."
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual merit of performing prayers at their earliest time according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) underscores the virtue of *al-ibkar* (early performance) of prayers, using a hyperbolic comparison to show that the reward of timely prayer surpasses even one's offspring and wealth. This reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on *al-ibkar* as a means of purifying the soul from worldly distractions and securing divine favor before the onset of other obligations. The comparison to offspring and wealth highlights the enduring spiritual legacy that outweighs temporal assets.
